[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Coleslaw with a Twist: Ingredients include grilled pineapple, jalapeño, cilantro, and balsamic glaze.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Grilled Corn with Herbs: Slather corn on the cob with compound butter made with parsley, chives, or cilantro.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Roasted Sweet Potato Salad: Roast sweet potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then toss with mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and citrus vinaigrette.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Smoky Baked Beans: Infuse baked beans with chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, brown sugar, and optional bourbon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Grilled Asparagus with Lemon Aioli: Brush asparagus with olive oil, season, grill, and serve with lemon aioli.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant suggested the following desserts:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Watermelon Basil Granita: Puree watermelon and basil, freeze, and scrape to form crystals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Grilled Pineapple with Brown Sugar Ice Cream: Grill pineapple slices and serve with brown sugar ice cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Summer Fruit Salad with Whipped Cream: Combine strawberries, blueberries, and peaches with whipped cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Cornbread with Strawberry Jam and Whipped Cream: Serve cornbread with strawberry jam and whipped cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. No-Bake Energy Bites: Made with rolled oats, peanut butter, honey, and chocolate chips.
